documentation_only_layout_approval: The user explicitly permits carrying the previous review verdict across layout-only corrections. Preserve the original verdict and link the precise approval, unchanged content basis, old/new outputVersion and ordered old/new image hashes. Semantic or content changes still require re-review. The current generic domain does not implement this carry-over.
documentation_only_latest_work_state: Latest instruction supersedes the temporary publishing hold: preserve existing published posts and 20 existing schedules; finish 5 immediate test posts on each platform first; query held schedules before restoring original future times while preserving provider IDs; reactivate refill automation. These are instructions, not verified provider operations. Production/review/integration improvements proceed separately. Do not silently overwrite current assets/verdicts or add a new publication blocker. Link a validated new vertical render to the previous version without deletion. Layout-only approval carry-over remains authorized; semantic changes require re-review.
documentation_only_validation: Only productionVersion and validateProductionCaptions are exercised against the actual module. Other shapes are documentary examples with no real assets, approval or provider response.
documentation_only_instruction_history: Previous instruction to pause new publishing/refill and hold unpublished schedules is superseded by the latest posting-first instruction. Actual historical hold state still requires provider read-back.
documentation_only_registration_config: Public examples must use synthetic roots and role names. No private PC paths, real account/provider IDs or actor chat IDs belong in published example configuration.
